title: Pixel Fury: Making a 2D Retro Fighting Game with Claude Fable 5 and Higgsfield
author: Fair_Biscotti_8363

comments.author: JoeEnderman
comments.body: What's the workflow? Is this an actual game or just an ad?

replies.author: Fair_Biscotti_8363
replies.body: It's a playable prototype - you can try it here: [https://galcoreart.itch.io/pixel-fury](https://galcoreart.itch.io/pixel-fury) The workflow is just what's in the video - after connecting Higgsfield MCP to Claude, just entered the prompt as shown and Fable5 built the whole game from there in one shot. Only needed to adjust the sprite positioning for second pass but pretty amazing what it can do in less than half an hour

comments.author: Square-Yam-3772
comments.body:
I like how you have a ryu clone there and somehow his animation is super choppy. 

FYI, there is an option to choose ryu with orange outfit in street fighter.

replies.author: Fair_Biscotti_8363
replies.body: His name is Kael, not Ryu 👀 It’s not a real game by the way, just a test to see if Fable5 could make something playable with animations in a few minutes, which it did. SF2 8-bit and 16-bit 90s versions had similarly choppy animations - that’s the aesthetic Claude was intentionally going for!

replies.author: Square-Yam-3772
replies.body: the choppiness you have is not even SF2. its more like SF1

replies.author: Fair_Biscotti_8363
replies.body: Depends what system you were playing it on 👀 https://youtu.be/i0YVz9MaHGM Btw I didn’t animate this, Fable did and made the animation choppy for aesthetic retro-vibe reasons. I think it did a pretty good job for less than half an hour working on it
